notes:
Prism Devtools Collective: builds IDE-integrated copilots and hosted code-assist services. Primary ask: agents can call functions to run tests, lint, and builds in a hermetic sandbox and stream logs back to editor with very low latency. Requirements: 1) sandboxed test runner: ephemeral containers/chroot, no outbound network by default, syscall whitelist, cgroups limits, artifacts signed and returned. Time budget per run 30s-2m. 2) deterministic lint runs that return structured patch suggestions via function-call API; cache results for unchanged commits. 3) build log ingestion from GH Actions/GitLab; retention configurable (30/90/365d), EU-only buckets for some customers. 4) function-calling API must provide ephemeral creds, per-call audit trail, and integration with KMS/HSM for signing. 5) model pinning: pin major.minor model versions and quantized variants; prefer <200ms cold start for pinned variants; editor median token latency <=50ms. 6) routing: route private repos to dedicated pools; automatic fallback to cheaper variants on capacity. Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM, SOC2/ISO27001 references, full audit logs, retention controls. Performance SLOs and burst capacity expectations included.

Timeline: 2025-10-05 inbound from OSS meetup (AE assigned). 2025-11-12 kickoff call: "need safe exec of tests inside repo". 2026-01-19 initial security questionnaire completed; asked SAML and residency options. 2026-02-18 POC scoping deep-dive (ff_20260218_prism_poc). 2026-03-05 security review (ff_20260305_security_review) requested syscall whitelist and KMS flow. 2026-03-08 pricing and POC design shared. 2026-03-10 updated record; next: infra POC + SAML test tenant.

Quotes: "We can't let agents access network - must be hermetic; results only via signed artifact." "Editor latency is make-or-break; if completions lag >100ms engineers notice immediately."

Integrations: GitHub/GitLab apps, GH Actions triggers, S3-compatible EU buckets, KMS/HSM signing, SIEM -> Splunk/Datadog, SCIM user sync.
